name: A Street Learns to Float
prompt: Lift a row of thin balconies a few metres off the ground with oblong apricot gasbags. The broken staircases beneath become picnic stands. Show neighbours passing a teapot between two balconies whose mooring lines are just taut.

name: The Rain Inheritance
prompt: Cluster translucent pear-shaped bladders on forked wooden supports. Small crews collect the rain caught inside through long blue ribbons of hose, filling painted bowls. One newly emptied bladder droops beside its full, glittering neighbours.

name: The Great Knot Garden
prompt: Arrange earthbound balloonists around one enormous braided knot laid across a lawn. Each strand rises into a different potbellied black-and-gold balloon at the perimeter. Families walk the coloured strands to find their gondola.

name: Before the Lanterns Wake
prompt: Spread nearly flat lantern skins over hexagonal drying racks, a patchwork of vermilion tissue and inked moth wings. At one end two inflated skins stand upright as people slide wicker cradles underneath.

name: The Low Cloud Ferry
prompt: Stretch two parallel rows of tiny docking ladders under a single immensely long, low, mint-green envelope. Separate passenger baskets shuttle sideways beneath its belly. A waiting traveller holds a bright parcel over the gap.
